thread.title: Operations Alert

m1.name: Cluega
m1.text: Anomaly alert: The Vietnam store on TikTok Shop saw conversion suddenly drop 45% in the past hour. Competitor analysis shows the main rival just launched a "Buy One Get One Free" campaign, making our pricing uncompetitive. If left unaddressed, we estimate a potential profit loss of $1,200 USD today.

m2.name: Marcus
m2.text: Have you diagnosed the cause? What profit room do we currently have to adjust accordingly?

m3.name: Cluega
m3.text: Diagnosis complete: I recommend activating the "Multi-item discount" auto-fix immediately. Based on current supply-chain inventory and margins, I've found the optimal solution: set "Buy 2, get 15% off" — matching the competitor's appeal while maintaining an 18% net margin.

intro.lead: A new way to run commerce.
intro.rest: Shaped by real SEA commerce, powered by agents, designed for speed.

purpose.title: Built for commerce
purpose.body: Shaped by real SEA commerce ops, not a generic chatbot.

agents.title: Powered by AI agents
agents.body: Specialists collaborate: diagnose, grow, create, operate.

speed.title: Designed for speed
speed.body: Always on, instant diagnosis, one instruction runs end-to-end.

intake.title:
Know what's wrong
before it costs you
intake.body: Cluega watches orders, inventory and conversion around the clock. When something shifts, it doesn't just alert you — it diagnoses the cause and tells you how to fix it, before you open the dashboard.

plan.title:
Show up everywhere
buyers search
plan.body: Get your products found on Google and TikTok search, and recommended by AI search like ChatGPT and Perplexity — without learning the difference between SEO and GEO.

build.title:
A month of content
in minutes
build.body: Cluega generates a full month of social content, schedules it across channels, and tracks performance — learning what works and adapting over time, cutting manual work dramatically.

diffs.title:
Every channel has a playbook.
You have them all
diffs.body: Built-in skills for Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and Shopify. Expand to new channels without starting from scratch, and track every channel's performance in one place.

monitor.title:
One instruction
runs end-to-end
monitor.body: Give an instruction in chat and Cluega executes across steps on your store: conversational ops, automated skills, channel connectors and scheduled autonomy — four modules, one ops engine.
